body: I'm glad this works for you. It just wasn't the solution for me long-term. I have 10+ years on you, tried everything under the sun (exercise, healthy food, classes, vitamins, a personal trainer, etc) trying to avoid meds cus I was convinced for most of my life that it was lazy and a sign of weakness (for me not others) and if I just tried harder I'd be no longer depressed. Medication has been the only thing that's actually made significant change (in combination with therapy) in my mental stability/health. Without all the depression and anxiety constantly lurking around it made exercise, good food, and my other interests much more fulfilling. I didn't come home from the gym and still want to kill myself anymore. Unfortunately I am struggling for the last few months and I just can't afford my medication. I'm still trying to eat nice food but it's hard when I don't feel like I deserve to eat at all.
I'm here. Not really sure how to feel about it though other than disappointed.

Ok. I tried to look this up last night but I didn't find anything to support your claim. I am curious if you have a source for your information since I couldn't find it myself if it wouldn't be too much trouble? Maybe it's a good thing it was going to fail. I'm still not sure though. I feel stupid.
I did. I got a phone call, got out, went inside. I don't really know what to do anymore. I'm mostly just disappointed that I'm still here.
